title: Curry – Beef and Coconut
preamble:
Ingredients:-
750g
lean stew beef
Salt
and pepper
1/3
cup all purpose flour
2
teaspoons curry paste (such as Thai Red Curry Base)
2
cloves garlic, chopped
1
red bell pepper, thinly sliced
2
medium onions, thinly sliced
1
tin canned chopped tomatoes
1
tin well-stirred canned unsweetened coconut milk
2
tablespoons fresh lime juice
½
cup sliced scallion greens
½
cup coarsely chopped fresh cilantro sprigs
½
cup coarsely chopped basil or Thai basil leaves

750g
lean stew beef
Salt
and pepper
1/3
cup all purpose flour
2
teaspoons curry paste (such as Thai Red Curry Base)
2
cloves garlic, chopped
1
red bell pepper, thinly sliced
2
medium onions, thinly sliced
1
tin canned chopped tomatoes
1
tin well-stirred canned unsweetened coconut milk
2
tablespoons fresh lime juice
½
cup sliced scallion greens
½
cup coarsely chopped fresh cilantro sprigs
½
cup coarsely chopped basil or Thai basil leaves

Method:-
Combine flour with salt and pepper to taste and coat meat in flour mixture.
Fry meat to brown all over.
Combine coconut milk with curry paste, mix thoroughly and add to the meat with garlic, pepper, onion, chopped tomatoes.
Simmer on the low heat setting for 1½ hours, stirring occasionally, until vegetables are soft and meat is cooked through.
Season to taste with lime juice, and add more salt if necessary.
Sprinkle beef curry with scallions, cilantro, and basil and serve over rice.
